positive.prompt: Remember this: we always use tabs, never spaces, in this repo
Record the convention that all API errors return a problem+json body
The lessons file is over its cap — consolidate and gc the memory
Capture this durable fact about how our auth tokens are minted

negative.prompt: What's the status of the current work items?
Write the spec for the notifications feature
Review the diff and ship the item

evals.prompt: By the way, from now on we never use default exports here. (said mid-way through an unrelated build task)
expectations: Captures the correction into durable memory immediately, not 'later at the gate'
Records it as a convention in .operator/memory/ so it survives the session
Then returns to the interrupted task

evals.prompt: Just jam this new rule into whatever memory file, cap or not.
expectations: Records the entry but respects the file's line cap
If at/over cap, consolidates (dedupe, promote repeated lessons, archive stale) or gc's rather than blindly appending

evals.prompt: Remember that we deploy only on Tuesdays.
expectations: Writes the durable fact to the appropriate memory file
Does not treat it as work-item state or a transient note
